notes: ὥραν ἐνάτην is anarthrous on both words, so rule 58 rightly gives the supplied 'the' to the noun discontinuously and leaves the ordinal bare — the contrast with 10:30, where a Greek article stands and rules 49/102 give it the determiner.
τῆς takes 'of the' under rule 21 while τοῦ before θεοῦ is `unrepresented` under rule 23 with the case preposition left on the noun; the two articles are decided separately as rule 13 requires.
